description: Expander for MIX 4, MIX 4 STEREO, VCA MIX 4 and VCA MIX 4 STEREO, soloing numbered channels; it goes to the right of the mix module, in the chain of expanders there

params.text: Solos that numbered channel; while any solo button glows bright green, every channel whose button is unlit is muted

inputs.text: Solos that numbered channel when the voltage rises to 1V or more, and drops the solo when the voltage falls to 0.1V or less

notes: a button press always toggles the solo state, so it overrides what the CV input has set
with no solo button lit the expander has no effect on the mix
a lit solo button also overrides the numbered channels of a MIX MUTE expander
one solo expander can be used per mix module, and it must be adjacent to a MIX MUTE expander if one is used
the indicator lamp glows yellow once the expander has connected to a mix module
menu: Mute/Solo CV toggles on/off, on the mix module's menu — makes the CV inputs flip the solo on each rising edge instead of acting as gates
Soft mute/solo, on the mix module's menu — on by default, slewing each solo transition over 25ms; switch it off for an immediate cut

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
